statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-33815 (GO-2026-4771) is a malformed-msgSize panic in pgproto3 Bind.Decode. The fix is upstream commit jackc/pgx@6dbad4c ('pgproto3: guard Bind.Decode against malformed msgSize'), which is present in pgx/v5 v5.9.0 and v5.9.1. The Go vulnerability database (govulndb) has not yet updated GO-2026-4771 to record v5.9.0 as the fixed version; a correction is tracked at https://github.com/golang/vulndb/issues/4943 with a pending merge at https://github.com/golang/vulndb/pull/4957. Images shipping pgx/v5@5.9.1 contain the patched Bind.Decode and are not affected.

CVE-2026-33815 is in pgproto3 Backend.Receive / Bind.Decode, which handles messages received by a PostgreSQL server. Grafana Alloy uses pgx/v5 exclusively as a client when connecting to PostgreSQL; it never instantiates a pgproto3.Backend or accepts PostgreSQL wire-protocol connections. The vulnerable server-side decode path is never executed.
